title: Sisig
description: Sisig is a dish from Philippines prepared with pork shoulder, garlic, yellow onion, light soy sauce. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Home sisig uses pork shoulder rather than customary chopped pig head and ears; eggs are fully cooked.

steps.instruction: Cook the listed ingredients in simmering water for about 50 minutes until tender; drain well if necessary.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 12 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 7 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
